description:
Hi everyone! 👋

We are Team MSA, and we're super excited to take on this year's NASA Space Apps Challenge! We're tackling the Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data challenge by building a smart "Super App." Our platform leverages NASA’s satellite telemetry data (soil moisture, weather insights, and crop adaptability) to guide farmers, while also incorporating an agricultural marketplace and a labor coordination hub to create a real social and economic impact.
summary:
YANBOO – Smart Agriculture Platform

YANBOO is a smart agricultural platform designed to help farmers overcome farming and marketing challenges and reduce crop waste.

The project introduces an integrated mobile application that supports farmers throughout the agricultural process, from choosing suitable crops and planting times to harvesting and selling their products.

YANBOO aims to use NASA satellite data, such as NASA POWER and NASA Earthdata, combined with weather information, to help farmers monitor climate conditions and make better agricultural decisions.

The platform also offers an agricultural marketplace where farmers can buy and sell crops and farming supplies, rent agricultural equipment, and find workers.

YANBOO aims to connect space technology with real agricultural needs, improve farmers' access to markets, reduce food waste, and support sustainable agriculture.

Our goal is to turn space data into practical solutions that make a difference on Earth.
details: YANBOO – Project Details YANBOO is a smart agricultural platform designed to support farmers from planting to harvesting and selling their crops. The platform aims to use NASA satellite data, such as NASA POWER and NASA Earthdata, along with weather information, to help farmers monitor climate conditions and make better farming decisions. It also provides an agricultural marketplace where farmers can buy and sell crops, purchase farming supplies, rent equipment, and find workers. Benefits and Expected Impact: - Reducing crop waste. - Improving farmers' access to markets. - Supporting smarter and more sustainable agriculture. - Connecting farmers with buyers and agricultural services. Innovation: YANBOO combines space technology with agricultural services in one platform, turning satellite data into practical solutions for real farming challenges. The project is currently at the initial concept stage, with NASA data integration and additional features planned for future development.
